title: Open Mic @ Ruby Beach Brewing
event_description: Weekly Sunday open mic night hosted by Torin Ance. Musicians are welcome to bring their own instruments and perform in a supportive environment. Food truck and craft beer available.
event_venue_information:
About Ruby Beach Brewing

Ruby Beach Brewing is a local craft brewery located in the historic Urban Core of Downtown Jacksonville. This beautifully renovated 119-year-old brick building houses a taproom with 18 beers brewed on-site plus guest taps for cider and mead. The venue features an inviting patio space and turfed backyard perfect for large groups with plenty of shade.

Music and Events

The brewery hosts weekly Sunday open mic nights and various live music events throughout the week. Located just steps from the iconic Florida Theatre and Elbow District making it a popular pre-show destination. The resident food truck Ruby Beach Smoke serves delicious bites seven days a week.

Atmosphere

Ruby Beach offers a higher-end industrial styled brewery with both indoor and outdoor seating options. The space is family and dog-friendly with ample parking. The venue also hosts weddings ceremonies corporate events and private celebrations in their event spaces including The Lawn The Lounge and The 2nd Floor.

title: Blue Jay Jazz Jam @ Blue Jay Listening Room
event_description: Weekly Tuesday night jazz jam session at Jacksonville Beach's premier listening room. Professional musicians and students welcome. Cover charge $10 at door ($5 with valid student ID). This intimate 80-capacity venue demands audience respect and attention.
backline: PA System; Keyboard; Electric Bass and Amp; Drums; Guitar Amp
event_venue_information:
About Blue Jay Listening Room

Blue Jay Listening Room is a beautifully intimate music venue established in 2017 in South Jacksonville Beach. Located upstairs from Casa Maria Mexican Restaurant in the Costa Verde Plaza this sacred 80-capacity listening room offers a unique concert experience where every ticket feels like a backstage pass.

The Listening Room Experience

The venue operates on a simple but important rule: be quiet and listen. Blue Jay creates an intentional listening environment where audiences connect deeply with performers through songs and intimate stories. Talking is encouraged before shows during set breaks and after performances but not during the music itself.

Music Programming

Blue Jay hosts concerts nearly every night of the week featuring local and internationally-touring songwriters across broad genres. Tuesday night jazz jams are a regular fixture along with monthly bluegrass jams and songwriter showcases. Doors typically open at 7 PM with shows starting at 8 PM. The venue serves wine and local craft beer.

Venue Details

Run by venue director Cara Murphy Blue Jay has established itself as Jacksonville Beach's award-winning listening room since opening. The cozy space allows audiences to experience music up close and personal with professional sound and lighting. Available for private events including birthday parties showers and weddings.

title: The Cypher Open Mic @ Eclipse Bar & Nightclub
event_description: Jacksonville's longest-running open mic celebrating 16 years strong. Weekly Thursday night featuring poetry soul and all genres of music. This historic open mic welcomes rappers singers poets and performers in a diverse and authentic entertainment atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Eclipse Bar & Nightclub

Eclipse Bar & Nightclub has become Jacksonville's premier venue for authentic alternative nightlife experiences since opening in the Riverside neighborhood. This spacious venue features comfortable indoor and outdoor lounge spaces a large dance floor with professional sound system and lighting and a complete full-service bar.

Music and Events

Eclipse hosts weekly themed nights including The Cypher Open Mic every Thursday (Jacksonville's longest-running open mic at 16 years) Karaoke Fridays Monday Night Football with flavored wings Country Roadhouse nights with line dancing and various live music performances. The venue is home to the First Saturday Lifestyle Party and regularly features guest DJs tribute bands and special themed events.

Atmosphere and Amenities

Eclipse prides itself on being a judgment-free zone where diverse crowds come together. The venue offers no cover charge most nights easy free parking and is open seven days a week until 2 AM. They specialize in live DJ dance parties karaoke special events and private party rentals. Famous for their signature Fuckit Buckit drink special and affordable drink specials throughout the week.

Community

Eclipse serves as an authentic community gathering place for real people creating real memories. The venue is LGBTQ+ friendly and welcomes all identities ages 21 and up. Event coordination and bottle service VIP tables available for special occasions.

title: Open Mic @ Mudville Music Room
event_description: Weekly Friday night open mic hosted by Mark Williams. Open to musicians comedians storytellers poets and all sorts of 4 to 12-minute acts. This listening room venue also features jazz performances and songwriter showcases in an intimate setting with full restaurant service.
event_venue_information:
About Mudville Music Room

Mudville Music Room is a listening room concert venue attached to Mudville Grille offering an intimate performance space separate from the restaurant. The venue prides itself on great food great atmosphere and great service in a family-owned and operated setting with a full liquor bar.

Music Programming

Mudville hosts a diverse array of musical performances including weekly open mic nights on Fridays classic jazz performances by the River City Rhythm Kings (1st and 3rd Mondays) featuring music from the 1920s-1940s including Louis Armstrong Fats Waller and Jelly Roll Morton. The venue also presents original singer-songwriter showcases touring artists and the TBA Big Band.

Venue Details

The listening room format provides an attentive audience for performers in a comfortable seated environment. Reservations are recommended and can be made by texting 904-485-0763 or emailing the venue. The intimate space allows for up-close experiences with local regional and touring musicians across multiple genres including folk blues jazz and original music.

Notable Features

Mudville features New Orleans-style revelry with audience participation in Saints Go Marching In parades during jazz performances. The venue supports both established and emerging artists with professional sound and a dedicated listening audience. Daily food specials available from the attached Mudville Grille restaurant.
